thought.text: `start.sh` has completed. Now let me verify all services are up and the frontend responds at http://localhost:3000.

reasoning_content:
start.sh has completed (the process is no longer running, and the log shows the final "Skipping removal of IPFS bootstrap peers" message). The IPFS API responds (the 405 for GET on /api/v0/id is just a quirk of the API; start.sh itself treats the connection as ready, because curl -s returned a response... no, actually, `curl -s http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null` succeeds if there's any response. No problem).

Next, check the containers and verify that the frontend is running on localhost:3000, the backend on 8000, and webui on 3333.
